fields.q: 你眼中有一种鸟类少见的坚定决心。
fields.en: There is a firm resolve in your eyes not often seen in birds.
fields.name: 赛奥朵拉

q.value: 你眼中有一种鸟类少见的坚定决心。

en.value: There is a firm resolve in your eyes not often seen in birds.

fields.q: 老实说，我不太喜欢虫子。你常吃虫子吗？
fields.en: In truth, I have no fondness for insects. Do you eat them often?
fields.name: 赛奥朵拉

q.value: 老实说，我不太喜欢虫子。你常吃虫子吗？

en.value: In truth, I have no fondness for insects. Do you eat them often?

fields.q: 我们自认受尤法斯的恩惠，所以不得不对她抱以应有的敬意。
fields.en: We see ourselves as indebted to Yu Phas, so we cannot help but afford her the proper reverence.
fields.name: 赛奥朵拉

q.value: 我们自认受尤法斯的恩惠，所以不得不对她抱以应有的敬意。

en.value: We see ourselves as indebted to Yu Phas, so we cannot help but afford her the proper reverence.

fields.en: I find myself somewhat weary of late…
fields.name: 赛奥朵拉

en.value: I find myself somewhat weary of late…

fields.q: 若能让这世界成为我的子民能繁荣生息之地，我便心满意足。
fields.en: If I can make this world a place where my people can thrive, I will consider myself satisfied.
fields.name: 赛奥朵拉

q.value: 若能让这世界成为我的子民能繁荣生息之地，我便心满意足。

en.value: If I can make this world a place where my people can thrive, I will consider myself satisfied.

fields.q: 小时候，我总是听着睡前故事和摇篮曲入睡。
fields.en: As a child, I used to fall asleep listening to bedtime stories and lullabies.
fields.name: 赛奥朵拉

q.value: 小时候，我总是听着睡前故事和摇篮曲入睡。

en.value: As a child, I used to fall asleep listening to bedtime stories and lullabies.

fields.q: 我渴望成为让尤法斯与萨拉米斯子民引以为傲的女王。
fields.en: I yearn to be a queen that Yu Phas and the people of Saramis can take pride in.
fields.name: 赛奥朵拉

q.value: 我渴望成为让尤法斯与萨拉米斯子民引以为傲的女王。

en.value: I yearn to be a queen that Yu Phas and the people of Saramis can take pride in.

fields.q: 我的臣下一看到我爱画的素描就皱眉。都怪我这只新手臂。
fields.en: My retainer winces at the sight of the sketches I enjoy drawing. I blame this new arm of mine.
fields.name: 赛奥朵拉

q.value: 我的臣下一看到我爱画的素描就皱眉。都怪我这只新手臂。

en.value: My retainer winces at the sight of the sketches I enjoy drawing. I blame this new arm of mine.

fields.q: 身为达马斯卡之子，要我信任神殿是不可能的。
fields.en: As a child of Damascar, I cannot be expected to place my trust in the temples.
fields.name: 赛奥朵拉

q.value: 身为达马斯卡之子，要我信任神殿是不可能的。

en.value: As a child of Damascar, I cannot be expected to place my trust in the temples.

fields.q: 我考虑过拿你来练枪术。你一定躲得开我的攻击吧。
fields.en: I have considered training my spear technique against you. Surely you can avoid my blows.
fields.name: 赛奥朵拉

q.value: 我考虑过拿你来练枪术。你一定躲得开我的攻击吧。

en.value: I have considered training my spear technique against you. Surely you can avoid my blows.
